summary: Vodafone Group filed a 6-K furnishing a Stock Exchange announcement dated 8 October 2026 titled VodafoneThree Investor Briefing. The registrant disclosed upgraded UK merger synergy targets of GBP 1 billion per annum by FY32 (previously GBP 0.7 billion by FY30), mid-to-high single digit Adjusted EBITDAaL CAGR (FY25-32) and operating free cash flow more than tripling by FY32 versus FY25, alongside an 11-year GBP 11 billion network investment plan. This is a routine investor briefing on an already-completed combination, not a new special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock are stated.
